_comment: Script classes mods extend that the source game never shipped, made from the class their author copied (see
docs/modding.md, "stand_ins.json"): copy is the class copied, extends what it extends instead, drop the methods left
out. A mod's stand_ins.json in its parts folder adds its own or replaces one of these by name. Block_Inline_OHV (the
Ford six's blocks) is Block_Vee_OHV with one cylinder head; its author's source sits among the SLRR notes, never compiled.
